title: Unraveling the electrolyte-free interface in membrane CO2 electrolysers
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7402-7412
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02408K, Perspective
Wenhao Ren, Yao Zheng, Shi-Zhang Qiao
We discuss emerging phenomena in membrane electrode assembly CO2 electrolysers and highlight the critical role of electrolyte-free interfaces in governing catalytic performance at the device level.
